hint_ladder.title: Follow Order of Operations (PEMDAS)
hint_ladder.text: Parentheses first, then multiplication/division, then addition/subtraction. Don't add 24 before multiplying.

hint_ladder.title: Add to Get the Final Answer

A.text: You might have chosen A because you ignored the operations and took only 24. Remember: solve the full expression with PEMDAS.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you incorrectly combined numbers: perhaps 24+8=32, then 32+6=38, forgetting the subtraction.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you calculated left-to-right: 24+8=32, 32-3=29, 29×2=58, but multiplication comes first.

next_time_rule: Tandaan: Sundin ang PEMDAS—Parentheses muna, tapos Multiply/Divide bago Add/Subtract. Huwag mag-left-to-right nang pabaya!
deconstruct_text:
Sa palengke, si Aling Nena ay may 24 pirasong paninda. Kinuha niya ang 8 kahon, binawasan ng 3, at dodoblehin ang dami. Ang matematika: 24 + (8 - 3) × 2.

Sundin ang order: Unahin ang Parentheses: (8 - 3) = 5. Kaya naging 24 + 5 × 2. Pagkatapos, Multiplication muna bago Addition: 5 × 2 = 10. Saka i-add: 24 + 10 = 34. Kaya ang tamang bilang ay 34 piraso.

Mental Trick: Tandaan ang PEMDAS bilang 'Pakiusap, Eksaktong Mag-DasAl Sagot' — Parentheses, Eksponents, Multiply/Divide, Add/Subtract. Laging unahin ang nasa loob ng parentheses at multiplication bago mag-add.
